changelog:
🚀 What's New in OFFPAY v4.0.0 (Build 400):
• 🛡️ Offline Payment Dual-Verification: Receiver cloud sync verifies sender cryptographic proof against Firebase Ledger before marking payments VERIFIED.
• ⚡ One-Tap Batch Synchronization: Tap 'Sync Now' once on the Home screen banner to synchronize all pending, received, and retrying offline transactions.
• 🏷️ Payment Method Tagging: Clearly distinguish Online Cloud vs Offline Bluetooth BLE payment methods with dynamic badges and metadata rows in transaction details.
• 📶 Cross-Version Bluetooth Compatibility: Optimized Android 8+ through Android 14+ discovery, advertisement packets, and GATT connection stability.
• 🔐 Pairing Security: Deterministic 6-digit Bluetooth pairing verification dialog before initiating offline transfers.
